extraFacts.fact: Unit conversions (1 bar = 14.5038 psi): 100 psi = about 7 bar; 120 psi = about 8 bar; 125 psi = about 9 bar; 140 psi = about 10 bar; 145 psi = 10 bar; 150 psi = about 10 bar; 200 psi = about 14 bar; 246 psi = about 17 bar; 250 psi = about 17 bar; 300 psi = about 21 bar; 350 psi = about 24 bar; 500 psi = about 34 bar. Temperature (°C = (°F - 32) / 1.8): -40°F = -40°C; -32°F = -36°C; -25°F = -32°C; -10°F = -23°C; -4°F = -20°C; 0°F = -18°C; 15°F = -9°C; 23°F = -5°C; 32°F = 0°C; 122°F = 50°C; 140°F = 60°C; 150°F = 66°C; 158°F = 70°C; 160°F = 71°C; 176°F = 80°C; 200°F = 93°C; 350°F = 177°C; 400°F = 204°C; 450°F = 232°C.
extraFacts.source: NIST SP 811 unit conversion; 1 bar = 14.5038 psi

extraFacts.fact: NPT is the American taper pipe thread to ASME B1.20.1 and NPTF is the dryseal version to ASME B1.20.3; BSPP (G) is parallel pipe thread to ISO 228-1 and BSPT (R) is taper pipe thread to ISO 7-1. NPT and BSP threads do not mate. FNPT is female NPT and MNPT is male NPT.
extraFacts.source: ASME B1.20.1; ASME B1.20.3; ISO 228-1; ISO 7-1

extraFacts.fact: HS 2022 heading 84.81 covers taps, cocks and valves: subheading 8481.20 valves for oleohydraulic or pneumatic transmissions, 8481.30 check (non-return) valves, 8481.40 safety or relief valves, 8481.80 other appliances. The importing country's tariff fixes the final national digits.
ISO 4414 sets the general rules and safety requirements for pneumatic fluid power systems, including that stored pressure be able to be isolated and exhausted before work on the machine.
extraFacts.source: ISO 4414:2010 Pneumatic fluid power - General rules and safety requirements for systems and their components

extraFacts.fact: Valve function is written as ways/positions: a 3/2 valve has three ports and two positions, a 4/2 valve four ports and two positions, a 4/3 valve four ports and three positions; a 3-position valve may have a closed centre or an exhaust centre.
extraFacts.source: ISO 1219-1 Fluid power systems and components - Graphical symbols and circuit diagrams (valve notation)

extraFacts.fact: SMC IL200 series lock-up valve: IL201 is the single-acting type and IL211 the double-acting type with 1/4 inch ports; a lock-up valve is fitted in an air-operated control line so that, if the air supply or supply piping fails, it traps the air in the actuator line and holds the actuator in position. IL220 is the version where the flow path between IN1 and OUT opens when the signal pressure drops. Suffixes in part numbers: N = NPT thread, T and L are option codes.
extraFacts.source: SMC Corporation catalogue, IL200 Series Lock-up Valve (smcusa.com product page and operation manual)

extraFacts.fact: SMC part numbers use N before the port code for an NPT thread (for example VH402-N04, 1/2 inch NPT, VM230-N02-00A) and a port code of 01, 02, 03, 04 or 06 for 1/8, 1/4, 3/8, 1/2 or 3/4 inch (VH601-N06 is 3/4 inch).
extraFacts.source: SMC Best Pneumatics catalogue, hand valve Series VH and mechanical valve Series VM, How to Order

extraFacts.fact: SMC VNA series media valves are 2-port (2-way) valves for fluids rather than plain air; the catalogue offers air-operated, electromagnetic and N.C. types with different pressure ranges.
extraFacts.source: SMC Corporation catalogue, Series VNA / VNB / VNC / VND media valves

extraFacts.fact: A shuttle valve has two inlets and one outlet: the outlet takes air from whichever inlet is pressurised (OR function). SMC VR1210F and VR1220F are shuttle valves with one-touch fittings.
extraFacts.source: SMC Best Pneumatics catalogue, Shuttle Valve Series VR1210/VR1220

faqs.q: What are Nitra ARV series shut-off valves used for?
faqs.a: Nitra ARV series valves are 3-port, 2-position normally closed twist-knob shut-off valves that isolate and vent compressed air at the head of a line or air-preparation unit. The listing has 3 part numbers: ARV-21, ARV-22 and ARV-32.

faqs.q: What do Nitra ARV-21, ARV-22 and ARV-32 part numbers mean?
faqs.a: On the rows the digits after ARV give the body and port: ARV-21 has a 1/8 inch female NPT inlet and ARV-22 and ARV-32 each have a 1/4 inch female NPT inlet. Quote the full number when you order.

faqs.q: What port sizes do Nitra ARV valves have?
faqs.a: The listing has 1/8 inch (ARV-21) and 1/4 inch (ARV-22, ARV-32) female NPT inlets. Check the row of the number you order against your line.

faqs.q: Which Nitra ARV valve should I choose, ARV-22 or ARV-32?
faqs.a: ARV-22 and ARV-32 share the same 1/4 inch female NPT inlet on their rows, so choose by the body style you need and ask us to confirm the difference before ordering. Our [guide to manual and pilot-operated air valves](/blog/manual-and-pilot-operated-air-valves) covers shut-off valves.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature rating do Nitra ARV valves have?
faqs.a: The maker pressure and temperature ratings are not held on this listing, so we do not state any. Ask us for the current Nitra data for the part number you want.

faqs.q: What connects to a Nitra ARV shut-off valve?
faqs.a: The inlet is female NPT, so use NPT fittings and nipples from our [pneumatic fittings shelf](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers). The valve vents downstream air through its exhaust port when closed.

faqs.q: How do you install a Nitra ARV twist-knob shut-off valve?
faqs.a: Fit it at the head of the circuit with the knob accessible and the exhaust port unobstructed, and use it to isolate and exhaust the line before service, as ISO 4414 requires.

faqs.q: How does the Nitra ARV compare with the Metal Work shut-off valve?
faqs.a: The Nitra ARV is a twist-knob shut-off in 1/8 and 1/4 inch, while the [Metal Work shut-off valve](/p/metal-work-shut-off-valves) is made for Syntesi size 1 units and also comes in a solenoid version.

faqs.q: Where is the Nitra ARV valve made and which HS code applies?
faqs.a: The recorded country of origin for the Nitra ARV series is China and the recorded HS code is 848140. Confirm the final tariff line for your destination country.

faqs.a: Yes, Nitra ARV series valves is held in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. For a quotation, send the part numbers you need and the quantities through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What is the Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve used for?
faqs.a: Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valves are 2-port, 2-position plunger valves that a push button operator or machine part presses to open or close an air path. The listing has 4 part numbers: EVP-AA-PL, EVP-AS-PL, EVP-CA-PL and EVP-CS-PL.

faqs.q: What do Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve part numbers such as EVP-AA-PL mean?
faqs.a: On the rows, EVP-A is normally open and EVP-C is normally closed, and the next letter shows the port style: A is axial ports and S is side ports. -PL marks the metal plunger with spring return.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve come in?
faqs.a: This listing is one body size with four variants: two normally open (EVP-AA-PL, EVP-AS-PL) and two normally closed (EVP-CA-PL, EVP-CS-PL), each with axial or side ports.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve?
faqs.a: Choose normally open (EVP-A) to pass air until the plunger is pressed and normally closed (EVP-C) to block it until pressed, then axial or side ports to suit the piping. See our [guide to manual and pilot-operated air valves](/blog/manual-and-pilot-operated-air-valves).

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature rating does the Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve have?
faqs.a: Nitra gives a maximum pressure of 145 psi (10 bar) for these valves on the listing. A temperature rating is not held, so ask us before use outside normal workshop air conditions.

faqs.q: What is the Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve made of?
faqs.a: The listing does not record the body or seal material of the Nitra EVP valves; the actuator is a metal plunger with spring return. Ask us for the material specification of your part number.

faqs.q: Does the Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve come with certificates?
faqs.a: We hold no certificate data for the Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve, so none is claimed here. Ask for a certificate of conformity or origin with your enquiry for EVP-AA-PL and we will tell you what can be supplied.

faqs.q: What connects to the Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve?
faqs.a: The valves are for use with pneumatic push button operators, so they sit under a push button or cam actuator. Pipe them with fittings from our [pneumatic fittings shelf](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers).

faqs.q: How do you install the Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve?
faqs.a: Mount the valve so the plunger is pressed squarely and not over-travelled, pipe it in the circuit and exhaust the line before service. Isolate and exhaust the line before any work on it, as ISO 4414 requires.

faqs.q: How does the Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve differ from its sibling listings?
faqs.a: The EVP is a 2-port plunger valve, while the [Nitra ARV valve](/p/nitra-arv-series-valves) is a 3-port twist-knob shut-off valve. Use the EVP for push button logic and the ARV for line isolation.

faqs.q: Where is the Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve made and which HS code applies?
faqs.a: The recorded country of origin for the Nitra EVP valves is Italy and the recorded HS code is 848120, the pneumatic-valve subheading of 84.81.

faqs.q: Do you stock the Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. the Nitra EVP pneumatic manual valve is stocked at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, with worldwide shipping and the best lead times. Quote the part numbers and quantities on [our contact page](/contact) and we will reply with price and delivery.

faqs.q: What is the Numatics L2 4-way 3-position lever manual air control valve used for?
faqs.a: The Numatics L2 series 4-way, 3-position lever valve lets an operator hand-select extend, stop or retract on a double-acting cylinder in applications such as pressing and bottling. The listing has 4 part numbers.

faqs.q: What do Numatics L2 4-way 3-position lever manual air control valve part numbers such as L23LD552O000000 mean?
faqs.a: On the rows L23LA552O000000 and L23LA652O000000 are spring-return levers with centre open and centre closed, and L23LD552O000000 and L23LD652O000000 are the detent versions. In the code 3 is the 3/8 inch port, A is spring and D is detent, and 5 or 6 sets the centre.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Numatics L2 4-way 3-position lever manual air control valve come in?
faqs.a: All four part numbers are 3/8 inch NPT, 4-way, 3-position inline valves, so the choice is lever return and centre condition rather than size.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right Numatics L2 4-way 3-position lever manual air control valve?
faqs.a: Choose centre open (L23LA552..., L23LD552...) to let the cylinder float and centre closed (L23LA652..., L23LD652...) to hold it; choose spring return for a deadman lever or detent to stay put. See our [guide to manual and pilot-operated air valves](/blog/manual-and-pilot-operated-air-valves).

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature rating does the Numatics L2 4-way 3-position lever manual air control valve have?
faqs.a: The listing is rated 145 psi (10 bar), -10°F to +150°F (about -23 to 66°C), and the valve is vacuum operable. Check the row of the exact part number before you rely on a rating, and ask us for the maker data if you need it.

faqs.q: What is the Numatics L2 4-way 3-position lever manual air control valve made of?
faqs.a: The body is aluminum with a lever actuator, inline body style and NPT connections. Ask us to confirm the material of the exact part number and the media it will see, because compatibility depends on the fluid, the temperature and the seal.

faqs.q: Does the Numatics L2 4-way 3-position lever manual air control valve come with certificates?
faqs.a: No certificates or approvals are recorded for the Numatics L2 4-way 3-position lever manual air control valve. Tell us what documents your project needs, such as a certificate of conformity or origin for L23LD552O000000, when you ask for a price.

faqs.q: What connects to the Numatics L2 4-way 3-position lever manual air control valve?
faqs.a: With 3/8 inch NPT ports, use NPT fittings from our [pneumatic fittings shelf](/c/pneumatic-fittings-silencers) for supply, the two cylinder lines and the exhausts. Match the port thread to the mating part and ask us if you are unsure of the combination.

faqs.q: How do you install the Numatics L2 4-way 3-position lever manual air control valve?
faqs.a: Mount the lever clear of other controls, pipe supply and cylinder ports as marked, and exhaust the circuit before service. Isolate and exhaust the line before any work on it, as ISO 4414 requires.

faqs.q: How does the Numatics L2 4-way 3-position lever manual air control valve differ from its sibling listings?

faqs.q: Where is the Numatics L2 4-way 3-position lever manual air control valve made and which HS code applies?

faqs.q: What is the Numatics L1/L2 air pilot 4-way valve used for?

faqs.q: What do Numatics L1/L2 air pilot 4-way valve part numbers such as L23PP552O000000 mean?
faqs.a: The rows show L12 numbers are 1/4 inch and L23 numbers 3/8 inch body-ported valves, 554 numbers are 1/2 inch base-mount valves, PA is pilot/spring and PP is pilot/pilot, and 4 or 5 or 6 in the code marks 2-position or 3-position versions.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Numatics L1/L2 air pilot 4-way valve come in?

faqs.q: How do I choose the right Numatics L1/L2 air pilot 4-way valve?
faqs.a: Choose pilot/spring (PA) to return when the signal is removed, pilot/pilot (PP) to hold until the opposite signal arrives, and a 3-position PP valve for a centre stop. See our [guide to manual and pilot-operated air valves](/blog/manual-and-pilot-operated-air-valves).

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature rating does the Numatics L1/L2 air pilot 4-way valve have?
